{"consolidated_memory":"SERIES: Infinite recursion in graph/traversal/walker.rs (graph engine)

Common pattern across all occasions:
- Location: graph/traversal/walker.rs, graph engine side
- Reproduction: walk the cyclic fixture graph
- Signal: stack grows until guard trips
- All fixed through PR submissions on dedicated fix branches

OCCASION 1 - [2026-01-29]
- Trigger: tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Root cause: error swallowed by bare except
- Result: throughput rose 91 percent, to 608 requests per second
- Fix: narrowed the handler and let the failure propagate
- PR #2443 on branch fix/infinite-recursion-1

OCCASION 2 - [2026-02-02]
- Trigger: clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
- Root cause: missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- Result: cold start dropped 81 percent, to 535 ms
- Fix: added the composite index and backfilled in batches
- PR #2575 on branch fix/infinite-recursion-2

OCCASION 3 - [2026-04-11]
- Trigger: traffic arriving through the corporate proxy
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- Result: flaky test went from 26 failures per hundred runs to zero
- Fix: prefetched the relation in a single query
- PR #3242 on branch fix/infinite-recursion-3

OCCASION 4 - [2026-06-17]
- Trigger: records carrying non-ASCII names
- Root cause: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Result: nightly rollup matched the source counts for 62 days running
- Fix: normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- PR #4108 on branch fix/infinite-recursion-4

OCCASION 5 - [2026-06-26]
- Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: listener registered but never removed
- Result: error rate dropped from 5.1 percent to under 8 per ten thousand
- Fix: removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
- PR #7331 on branch fix/infinite-recursion-5

OCCASION 6 - [2026-07-24]
- Trigger: staging read replica
- Root cause: schema drift between the migration and the model
- Result: 55 duplicate rows a day stopped being written
- Fix: regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum
- PR #9157 on branch fix/infinite-recursion-7

OCCASION 7 - [2026-08-20]
- Trigger: payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Root cause: floating point rounding in the money path
- Result: reclaimed 4 GB of blob storage
- Fix: moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
- PR #9555 on branch fix/infinite-recursion-8

Note: Context carried over from earlier infinite recursion work in the same corner of graph/traversal/walker.rs across all occasions."}
